description: Four-layer health audit that gates commits and pushes. Deterministic layers run in pre-commit and CI; the instruction-level layer is a human-invoked pre-merge gate.

steps.note: Reference integrity + layout + eval shape. Fast, deterministic, stdlib-only.

steps.on_blocking: fail — the auditor itself is broken; do not trust its findings
steps.note: Who audits the auditor: golden set + independent oracle + pinned hash.
Adversarial-consensus contradiction/drift check. Needs model access; not run headless in CI. Read-only.
Dry-run by default; mechanical-only with --apply; judgment items are human TODOs.

notes: Blocking findings in scan/data/self_test return exit 1 so the pre-commit hook and CI gate block the change. The instruction layer and repair never auto-edit semantic content — human-gated.
